messages:
devon: opened a small docs PR to update Console observability examples: migrate trace header examples to `traceparent`, refresh dashboard JSON to v2, and swap billing metric names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 — would love a quick snippet check.

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @devon — automated checks: linkcheck FAILED (1 outdated dashboard URL), lint queued.

maya: I'll take the snippets. quick heads-up: backend uses `token_unit_cost` now (not `token_cost`) and grouping key is `api_route`. also dashboard schema moved to `/dashboards/v2/schema` so update any links.

oscar: for snippets prefer per-request header injection. concise TS example I suggest:
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat-7b', messages:[{role:'user',content:'hi'}], headers:{ traceparent: '00-11111111111111111111111111111111-2222222222222222-01' } })
```

devon: nice. can we add a 1-line about sampling and a troubleshooting tip? e.g., "Default sampling is 1% for hosted traces; if traces are missing check proxies or sampling settings."

maya: added sampling note and proxy tip. fixed the dashboard URL to v2 and swapped metric names in the widget example. shortened code lines to satisfy lint and force-pushed.

docs-bot: Linkcheck passed. linter: minor code-block formatting warning resolved. Build preview ready.

oscar: final nit: include a tiny migration checklist at the top mapping old->new keys (token_cost -> token_unit_cost, route -> api_route). then we can merge once we have one more approval.

devon: added migration checklist and merged after approvals. thanks all :tada:
